june-2026.kidNote: Every child has rights! You have the right to go to school, play, eat good food, and be safe. These are your special rights.
Our Earth is our home! We should plant trees, save water, and not throw garbage on the ground. Let's keep our planet clean and green.
Along with rights, we also have duties. We should respect our teachers, keep our classroom clean, and be kind to everyone.
Always tell the truth! When we share something with friends, we should be honest and clear. Being truthful makes us good friends.
Deep inside the ocean, there are beautiful coral reefs where colourful fish live. We should protect the ocean so the fish have a happy home.
A leader helps others and shows the right way. You can be a leader too — by helping your friends, sharing your things, and being a good example.
When we promise to do something, we should always finish it. If you say you will help, make sure you do it! That is called commitment.
Always say the truth, even if it is hard. If you break something, tell your parents. Honest children are loved and trusted by everyone.
Some people have very light skin and hair. They are special just like you! We should be kind to everyone, no matter how they look.
Some people share their blood to help sick people get better. Doctors and nurses take care of us. When we grow up, we can help others too!
Some parents work far away to earn money for their family. They love their children so much! We should always love and respect our family.
Vegetables make us strong and healthy! Eat your carrots, spinach, and beans. They help you grow tall and give you energy to play.
Today we say THANK YOU to our dear father! Papa works hard, plays with us, and loves us so much. Give your father a big hug today!
If a friend says sorry, forgive them with a smile. Don't stay angry for long. When we forgive, we feel happy inside and our friendships grow stronger.
If you promise something, you must do it. When you say 'I will do my homework,' make sure you do it. People trust us when we keep our promises.
Yoga is exercise for our body and mind! Stretch your arms, touch your toes, and take deep breaths. Yoga makes us calm, strong, and happy.
Sometimes we share our favourite things with others. If your friend has no lunch, you share yours. Giving to others makes us feel really good inside.
Before computers, people used a special machine called a typewriter to write letters. Press a key and a letter appears on paper — like magic!
It's okay to feel shy sometimes. But try to raise your hand in class, say hello to friends, and speak up. You will feel braver each time you try!
Don't show off or think you are better than others. Be humble and kind. If we boast too much, we might make mistakes. Being simple is the best.
Muharam is an important day for our Muslim friends. It is a time to be good, think about others, and remember to always do what is right.
When you help a friend who is sad, you both feel better! Help others carry their bags, share your crayons, and cheer for your classmates.
Working together is fun! When we play in teams, we learn to share, listen, and help each other. Together we can do amazing things!
Our country has leaders who make rules to keep us safe. Just like your class monitor helps in school, these leaders help our whole country.
